description: This file defines a generic class 'CachingClientFactory' used to create, cache, and manage client instances with thread-safe mechanisms, including cache clearing, client retrieval, and concurrent creation handling. It extends 'ClientFactory' and leverages Vert.x for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: CachingClientFactory
classes.description: A generic factory class for creating, caching, and managing client instances of type T with thread-safe mechanisms, client liveness checks, and retry logic.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes a client from the cache, optionally processing it after removal.

methods.name: doClearState
methods.description: Clears the internal cache and locks to reset factory state.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the cache and creation locks are empty.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a cached client by key, or null if not present.

methods.name: getOrCreateClient
methods.description: Retrieves an existing client or creates a new one asynchronously, with retry logic for concurrent creation attempts.

methods.name: getOrCreateClient (private overload)
methods.description: Helper method to implement retry logic for creating clients, with exponential attempts up to MAX_CREATION_RETRIES.
